text: Branch `search-api` (6 commits off e8655c9's parent) was the first draft of the query-only API and was never merged. `dev` carries its ideas: `Hits`, `Location`, `Extraction`, `search_all`, `OpenOptions`, range reads and `libsufr/examples/search.rs`. Its `Context` struct is gone since 57d1235, which passes the extract window as two arguments. On 2026-11-19 the checkout on catalyst had no `origin/search-api` ref, and SSH to the remote was refused, so whether the branch still exists there is unchecked.
